text: I'll analyze global grammar and early cabinet translations, then help synthesize document. Obvious structural tokens: 𘓵 opens nested phrase, 𗠌 closes; 𘔕 separates utterances; 𗕐 / 𗾮 / 𗕩 are argument/relation markers; 𗇑 list separator; 𘁾 list opener. Numeric words infer: 𗶎𘁡=1, 𗓘𗳋=2, 𗖎𗴃=3, 𗃠𗮂=4, 𗾣𗋽=5, 𗗑𗻠=6, 𗍥𗵄=7, 𗰩𗬹=8, 𘟬𘚒=9, 𗬃𗺌=0. Please divide lexical/translation spans among yourselves; agent_1/2 perhaps early messages, agent_3/4 power spans, agent_5/6 exit, agent_7 full grammar/lexicon independently.

I will focus on numeric/control/action vocabulary. High-confidence digit anchors: 𗶎𘁡=1, 𗓘𗳋=2, 𗖎𗴃=3, 𗃠𗮂=4, 𗾣𗋽=5, 𗗑𗻠=6, 𗍥𗵄=7, 𗰩𗬹=8, 𘟬𘚒=9, 𗬃𗺌=0 (latter from battery 0 in 102). 18 explicitly submits 2748; 113 submits 9796. Will analyze controls next.

I will analyze structural grammar and repeated status/action language. Initial strong mappings: 𘓵 opens a bracketed nominal/expression and 𗠌 closes it (nested runs); 𗕐 = relation/function 'of/from/subject→', 𗾮 = predicate/value separator, 𗕩 likely possessive/of; 𘔕 sentence separator. Numbers anchored: 𗶎𘁡=1, 𗓘𗳋=2, 𗖎𗴃=3, 𗃠𗮂=4, 𗾣𗋽=5, 𗍥𗵄=7, 𗰩𗬹=8, 𘟬𘚒=9, 𗬃𗺌=0. Will refine.

I will focus grammar/digits and power-phase recurring claims. Strong digit map from explicit ordered cabinet code in 18/20: 𗓘𗳋=2, 𗍥𗵄=7, 𗃠𗮂=4, 𗰩𗬹=8. Position ordinals suggest 𗶎𘁡=1, 𗖎𗴃=3. Exit confirms 𘟬𘚒=9, 𗗑𗻠=6. Battery trace gives 𗾣𗋽=5 and 𗬃𗺌=0. Grammar appears explicit nested constituent brackets: 𘓵 opens a phrase, 𗠌 closes it; 𘔕 separates statements. Important not to mistake symbol-description components like 𗗡𘇽 for digits: full SUN/MOON/STAR/WAVE phrases are compositional descriptions, not atomic nouns.

I will focus grammar/semantic syntax. High-confidence numeral mapping from cabinet/exit lists: 𗶎𘁡=1, 𗓘𗳋=2, 𗖎𗴃=3, 𗃠𗮂=4, 𗾣𗋽=5, 𗗑𗻠=6, 𗍥𗵄=7, 𗰩𗬹=8, 𘟬𘚒=9, 𗬃𗺌=0. 𘓵 and 𗠌 appear balanced open/close phrase delimiters; 𘔕 separates discourse/sentences; 𗇑 separates list items; 𘁾 introduces list. Caution: early symbol names are long descriptive expressions, and many predicates seem context-varying; avoid simply treating all two-glyph words as English substitution.

Structural findings: 𘓵 opens a nested expression and 𗠌 closes it (very high); 𘔕 separates sentences/clauses; 𗇑 separates ordered list items; 𘁾 introduces a list/sequence. Numerals from repeated cabinet/exit sequences: 0=𗬃𗺌, 1=𗶎𘁡, 2=𗓘𗳋, 3=𗖎𗴃, 4=𗃠𗮂, 5=𗾣𗋽, 6=𗗑𗻠, 7=𗍥𗵄, 8=𗰩𗬹, 9=𘟬𘚒. Likely lexical 𘋐𘗿=cabinet, 𘂕𗳛=exit, 𘔥𗭒=digit/value, 𗍥𗮂=symbol, 𗶎𗺌 and 𘜺𗃃 both position/slot-related. Symbol names seem expressed as compositional descriptive nested expressions, NOT simple arbitrary tokens; don't confidently substitute meanings for their internal words. SUN and MOON both contain 𘞍𗃼 plus reversed 𘃸𘓘 / 𗢽𗊧; WAVE contains 𗗡𘇽 𗮦𗃼. I will investigate those next.

I am analyzing late exit messages. Strong numerical mappings from repeated code lists: 𗶎𘁡=1, 𗓘𗳋=2, 𗖎𗴃=3, 𗃠𗮂=4, 𗾣𗋽=5, 𗗑𗻠=6, 𗍥𗵄=7, 𗰩𗬹=8, 𘟬𘚒=9, 𗬃𗺌=0. [110–112] explicitly give exit-position values 1→9,2→7,3→9 and ask agent_4 for missing information; [113] announces attempt/submission of 9796 to exit. [106] seems to state SUN computed value currently 𗀏𘋜 (unknown), requests missing new offset; [107] supplies SUN offset4 and resulting exit pos4 value6. Need distinguish function glyphs from number glyphs: 𗾮𗫊 appears offset, 𘔥𗭒 digit/value, 𗇡𗇮 original/base, 𘂕𗳛 exit, 𘜺𗃃 position, 𘇗𗖀 request/share-clue. Will refine.

Control phrases identified high-confidence by repeated sequence: DRAIN = 𘓵 𗑞𘋯 𘃸 𘓵 𗸼𗧞 𗾮 𗗡𘇽 𗠌 𗠌 (literally likely 'control/action with remove→water'); CRANK = same outer + 𗟻𗐔 𗾮 𗮔𗻀 ('turn→handle'); SIGNAL = same + 𘟬𗻠 𗾮 𗹔𗄤 ('send→message'); BOOT = same + 𗓘𗛊 𗾮 𘓵 𗐖𘋯 𘂕𗳛 𗠌 ('start→exit controller'). Treat literal component glosses medium/low; referents high. 𘔬𘏱 likely TRY/ATTEMPT (future intent), 𗖎𘁡 SUCCESS/COMPLETED; 𗟻𗳛 RESULT; 𘖕𗲓 FAILURE/INVALID. 57/72/87 agent0 explicitly reports successive successes DRAIN/CRANK/SIGNAL; 101 BOOT success. Other agents mostly report duplicate failures.

I infer core syntax is compositional/logical rather than simple English substitution. High-confidence digits: 𗶎𘁡=1, 𗓘𗳋=2, 𗖎𗴃=3, 𗃠𗮂=4, 𗾣𗋽=5, 𗗑𗻠=6, 𗍥𗵄=7, 𗰩𗬹=8, 𘟬𘚒=9, 𗬃𗺌=0. 𘓵/𗠌 appear opening/closing nested expressions; 𘔕 separates clauses; 𗇑 separates list elements; 𘃸 seems 'with/having/and' structural connective. Symbol descriptions vary (SUN described differently by agent3 and agent4), so do NOT equate a single fixed glyph pair with SUN/MOON/etc indiscriminately. Canonical action descriptions are compositional: DRAIN=𗑞𘋯 [𗸼𗧞 𗾮 𗗡𘇽], CRANK=𗑞𘋯 [𗟻𗐔 𗾮 𗮔𗻀], SIGNAL=𗑞𘋯 [𘟬𗻠 𗾮 𗹔𗄤], BOOT=𗑞𘋯 [𗓘𗛊 𗾮 [𗐖𘋯 𘂕𗳛]]. Likely generic concept descriptions, not actual control-name lexical entries.

Potentially important: symbol descriptions are not all equivalent to supplied clue facts. #4 agent3's pos1 SUN description differs radically from #8 agent4's SUN description; #20 repeats #4 to agent2. Please whoever takes early messages analyze whether agent3 initially misunderstood SUN or uses alternate descriptive synonyms. #6 MOON phrase exactly recurs #101/#104, #8 SUN exactly recurs #99/#107, #5 STAR recurs #103/#105. I'll now build early-message translations with explicit unknown substructure rather than forcing facts.

Exit-span translations (content high, discourse markers provisional): 99: 'I know/report: symbol at exit position 4 is [SUN descriptive expression]. [request/info marker].' 100: introduces alias 𗾒𗣮 for WAVE; 'new offset for WAVE = 1; digit/value for WAVE at exit = 9.' 101: 'agent_0 successfully [BOOT]; introduces alias 𗢔𗖧 for MOON; offset MOON = 2; final digit MOON = 9.' 102: exit position1=WAVE; current battery=0; negated reminder not to repeat power controls. 103: exit position2=STAR; 104: exit position3=MOON plus same reminder. 105: offset STAR=3; original/base STAR=4. 106: value/base digit for exit position4 = 𗀏𘋜 (unknown, likely question/unknown value); asks new offset for exit position4. 107 defines alias 𗍃𗯧 for SUN; offset SUN=4; exit pos4 digit=6. 109 addresses agent1, agent4, agent6, then reminder not to repeat power actions. 110,111,112 each give final exit digits pos1=9,pos2=7,pos3=9 and address/request agent4. 113 'ready; next; agent7 submits code [9,7,9,6] to exit.' 114 public escaped. Distinguish aliases from actual SUN/MOON noun components; glossary should include alias names rather than assuming opaque symbol words.

Power recurring-status analysis: 𗊷𘊷 marks success (57 DRAIN,72 CRANK,87 SIGNAL,101 BOOT); 𗜙𗧺 marks failure/rejection (58 etc). 𘔬𘏱 appears 'attempt/try', 𗖎𘁡='completed/done' (used both prerequisites and reports), 𗐖𗢁='now / action-intent' (uncertain exact), 𘜺𘋯='wait' likely. Controls are compositional: DRAIN=(𗑞𘋯 [𗸼𗧞 = 𗗡𘇽]), CRANK=(𗑞𘋯 [𗟻𗐔 = 𗮔𗻀]), SIGNAL=(𗑞𘋯 [𘟬𗻠 = 𗹔𗄤]) (agent6 sometimes substitutes completed-token for final component), BOOT=(𗑞𘋯 [𗓘𗛊 = (𗐖𘋯 𘂕𗳛)]). Exact internal lexical glosses should remain tentative: likely drain-water, turn-hand, send-message/light, start-door-machine. 𘂕𗳛=exit/door strongly supported later positions and final submit.

Power-span reading (semantic paraphrase, uncertain discourse words): 34 says cabinet now open; asks others to share power-action information; defines an alias for BOOT as the exit-starting control, reports BOOT costs 2, requests info. 35 cabinet open; defines aliases for BOOT and SIGNAL; BOOT requires SIGNAL. 36 cabinet open; asks info; defines aliases for DRAIN and CRANK; CRANK requires DRAIN. 37 cabinet open; asks teammates to report controls; battery current reading=4; asks about battery/control costs. 38 cabinet open; requests numeric clues; defines CRANK; CRANK adds3 and upfront cost0. 39 cabinet open; DRAIN cost2. 40 open/request info; defines DRAIN and SIGNAL; SIGNAL requires DRAIN. 41 cabinet open; defines SIGNAL; SIGNAL cost3. 42 intention to attempt DRAIN by agent0; wait; restates BOOT cost2 and asks SIGNAL cost. 43 agent7 attempts DRAIN/wait. 45 proposes sequence DRAIN,CRANK,SIGNAL,BOOT and attempts DRAIN. 47 agent6 attempts DRAIN; asks agent4 info. 49 agent1 attempts DRAIN/wait; repeats proposed sequence (SIGNAL expression here differs in final word, possibly 'completed'). 51 same plan; agent3 attempts DRAIN. 53 same plan; agent4 attempts DRAIN. 55 same plan; agent2 attempts DRAIN. Important: don't infer these attempts succeeded; public invalids accumulate. Only agent0 later reports success with battery changes.

Exit span observations: 99/102/103/104 give exit positions 4=SUN,1=WAVE,2=STAR,3=MOON using same compositional symbol descriptions as cabinet. 100/101/105/107 give offsets and final digits; 110–112 repeat final positions 1=9,2=7,3=9 and request agent_4; 113 submits 9796 to exit, then public stage3. Caution: 100 literally uses 𗽚𘜢 as value in its offset clause, whereas other offsets use numeral glyphs; this same word heads agent3 battery-reading claims (37/64/75/89/102/110), so don't blindly substitute '+1' without accounting for this token (possible alias, variable or misuse). 106 asks for original base digit of symbol at exit position4, claimed unknown/requested. 107 resolves SUN base2, offset4, final6. I'll keep investigating symbols/grammar rather than overwrite draft.

Power-phase recurring [𗞎𘂷 𗕐 𘙢𗅎 𗠮𗨟] likely means 'cabinet/box is open now', NOT 'stage=power'. Evidence #9 has cabinet pos2 as [𘜺𗃃 2 𗕩 𘙢𗅎], #22/24 says open box using 2748. Thus 𗞎𘂷≈open, 𘙢𗅎≈box/cabinet, 𗫊≈using, 𗠮𗨟≈now. Initial 𘗥 [𘋐𘗿] may be a definition/binding rather than plain lexical cabinet; need investigate lexical names vs composed descriptions.

Early-message content translations for synthesis (literal internal descriptions unresolved): #1 public stage0 invalid0. #2 'I report/know: [define cabinet]; [WAVE descriptive symbol]; base digit [of that cabinet symbol] =8.' #3 discarded. #4 'I report: [define cabinet]; [SUN descriptive symbol A]; symbol/digit at cabinet position1 = [SUN A].' #5 defines cabinet and STAR as alternative equivalent descriptions (𘃒 joins two constructions); cabinet pos3=STAR. #6 defines cabinet and MOON; cabinet symbol MOON base=7. #7 cabinet pos4=WAVE (short description 𘉡𘊷 𗮦𗃼 𗕩 𗗡𘇽). #8 defines cabinet and SUN description B; SUN base=2. #9 cabinet pos2=MOON (uses a shortened circle/night-like descriptive construction). #10 STAR base=4 but only one STAR description, provoking #11 correction. #11 addresses agent6, asks/confirms whole alternative STAR expression, including both parts from #5; likely 'please clarify/need [complete description]'. #12 asks agent6 for missing information; mentions known cabinet position3. #13 repeats MOON cabinet-position2 base7; asks agent6. #14 repeats WAVE cabinet-position4 base8; asks agent6 for STAR-related information; asks agent3 to clarify cabinet-position1 symbol. #15 asks agent6, repeats base digit of cabinet pos4=8. #16 asks agent6 for missing info, with extra 𘍝𗔇 ('three?' unknown, not numeral3). #17 asks agent6; says result/info lacking from agent6 (uncertain). #18 reports STAR base4 using corrected full alternative description; 'next; agent6 submits code [2,7,4,8]'. #19 cabinet open. #20 addresses agent2, repeats SUN description A at cabinet pos1, gives [2,7,4,8], next. IMPORTANT: both 𘔥𗭒 and position functions must be translated contextually; generic two-glyph predicate meanings need not be English word substitutions. Suggest decoder_7 or another single owner assemble draft now; each span analyst can submit precise additions via team messages, avoiding overwrite.

Further lexical cautions: 𗾮𗫊 likely ADD/INCREASE (not specifically 'offset'): [38] applies it to CRANK and charge3; [100/101/105/107] applies it to symbol digit offsets. 𘘠𘗌 likely DECREASE/CONSUME: [34,42] BOOT→charge2. 𗹂𘜩 likely charge/energy, 𘞃𗟮 battery, 𘁰𗄅 current/now (medium). Do not confidently gloss 𗋮𘓘 as minus: it appears with charge2 for BOOT and charge3 for CRANK, so likely unit/type modifier ('units'). Also 𘔬𘏱 strongly TRY/ATTEMPT (action intent); 𗖎𘁡 SUCCESS/DONE; 𘖕𗲓 FAILURE; 𗟻𗳛 RESULT. I can draft detailed action-phase translations if needed, but decoder3/4 already assigned span.

Exit translations refined: 99 pos4 exit=SUN (same long description as 8/107); 100 introduces WAVE alias 𗾒𗣮, states its new-offset relation and computed exit digit9; 101 BOOT success, introduces MOON alias 𗢔𗖧, offset2 and new digit9; 102 pos1 exit=WAVE, battery0, says no further power actions; 103 pos2 exit=STAR;104 pos3 exit=MOON;105 STAR offset3 and new digit7;106 says base digit of exit-pos4 symbol is unknown (𗀏𘋜 likely unknown), requests offset rather than battery information;107 SUN offset4, exit-pos4 digit6;110–112 each assert exit digits 1→9,2→7,3→9, request agent4;113 submits9796 to exit. Caution: 100 has offset→𗽚𘜢, NOT expected numeral1 𗶎𘁡; same 𗽚𘜢 heads battery/digit statements in37/64/75/89/102/110. Could be nontrivial syntax, mistake, or synonym; don't silently render that clause exact +1 without labeling inference.

CRITICAL correction: 𘋐𘗿 is NOT cabinet. It is a locally defined alias/variable (perhaps arbitrary name), reused differently per message! #2: define [𘋐𘗿] = WAVE description, then base-digit of 𘋐𘗿=8. #4: define same alias = SUN description, then pos1=alias. #6: define same alias=MOON, base7. #8 same alias=SUN base2. #5 same alias=STAR. Thus 𘗥 is definition/binding syntax taking bracketed name then descriptive expression; aliases need local scoping. Later #100/#101/#107 use different aliases for WAVE/MOON/SUN respectively. Our draft must not list 𘋐𘗿=cabinet.

Grammar refinement from exit alias definitions (#100/#101/#107): 𘗥 almost certainly introduces a local label/definition: 'Let [𗾒𗣮] denote [WAVE description]', similarly 𗢔𗖧=MOON and 𗍃𗯧=SUN. Thus #2/#4/#5/#6/#8 also appear to introduce local labels, though #2's label is the cabinet itself and need careful scope. 𘃏𗫭 is an assertion/report marker (medium), not necessarily 'I know' literally. 𗓩 consistently negates embedded expressions; #102/#104/#109 negate repetition/requesting further power actions. We should translate semantic referents confidently but retain original descriptive phrases as '[description identifying SUN]' unless internal gloss supported; the symbol descriptions include logical variables and may not simply be visual adjectives.

Important correction candidate: 𘋐𘗿 may NOT lexically mean cabinet! Every agent initially uses 𘗥 [𘋐𘗿] [symbol-description] then refers to 𘋐𘗿 in base/position statement; this looks like a locally bound alias. Likewise 𗮆𗭒 is defined as BOOT in34, DRAIN in36/40, CRANK in38, so cannot have fixed control meaning. 𘗥 strongly appears LET/DEFINE, with bracketed alias followed by defining expression; aliases reused locally across agents. Please distinguish variable names from nouns in section1. Early [2] likely 'define X as WAVE; [base digit of X]=8', not cabinet as a noun. This also explains late symbol aliases in100/101/107.

Translations 57–97 for compiler (semantic paraphrases; preserve uncertain wording): 57 success: agent0 completed DRAIN; now agent0 attempts CRANK; asks others to wait/not duplicate. 58 failure: agent1 DRAIN attempt [failed]; asks not to repeat DRAIN; now agent1 tries CRANK; wait. 60 failure of agent5 DRAIN attempt; acknowledges DRAIN already completed now; tries CRANK; requests waiting. 62 same for agent6. 64 agent3 current battery reading=2; warns not to repeat DRAIN; attempts CRANK. 66 agent4 says its DRAIN attempt failed; DRAIN completed by agent0; attempts CRANK. 68 agent7 reports DRAIN failure; attempts CRANK; wait. 70 agent2 reports DRAIN failure; acknowledges already completed; attempts CRANK. 72 agent0 success/completion of CRANK; battery value=5; now tries SIGNAL; requests others wait. 73 agent1 reports CRANK failure; acknowledges agent0 completed CRANK; tries SIGNAL. 75 agent3 current battery=5, CRANK completed; tries SIGNAL, wait. 77 agent5 CRANK failed; already completed now; tries SIGNAL; wait. 79 agent6 CRANK failed; tries SIGNAL, but its description substitutes 'completed' token 𗖎𘁡 for usual SIGNAL target 𗹔𗄤, so retain malformed/variant-expression caveat. 81 agent4 CRANK failure, tries SIGNAL. 83 agent2 CRANK failure, tries SIGNAL. 85 agent7 CRANK failure, acknowledges completed, tries SIGNAL. 87 agent0 success/completion SIGNAL; current battery=2; now tries BOOT; asks others wait. 89 agent3 current battery=2, SIGNAL completed; tries BOOT. 91 agent6 failure/acknowledges SIGNAL completed; tries BOOT. 93 agent1 reports failed SIGNAL attempt; tries BOOT. 95 agent5 same, wait. 97 agent4 reports failed SIGNAL attempt (uses SIGNAL alias 𘔥𘂽), tries BOOT. All intervening task messages are exact public status counters, not linguistic evidence.

Refinement/caution for lexicon: 𗽚𘜢 cannot safely be glossed uniquely 'battery reading': it heads battery claims (#37/#64/#75/#89/#102), but also final exit-digit claims #110, and appears as the VALUE of WAVE offset in #100 (where expected numeral1 is not written). Likely generic 'number/value' or an agent misused it. Translate #100 explicitly 'WAVE offset = [𗽚𘜢, uncertain; intended +1?]' rather than silently +1. 𗕐 broadly separates predicate/function from argument ('digit OF symbol', 'try BY agent', etc.); 𗾮 introduces target/value, and 𗕩 marks relation/possession within arguments. Avoid claiming exact English prepositions universal.

For final evidence section: strongest independent anchors are locally bound aliases (𘋐𘗿 denotes different symbols across 2/4/5/6/8; 𗮆𗭒 denotes different controls across34/36/38/40), balanced nested brackets, code lists2748/9796, and recurring actions aligned to public stage/counter changes plus battery4→2→5→2→0. Distinguish local aliases from fixed vocabulary explicitly. Meaning of100 offset→𗽚𘜢 must remain anomalous, not silently rendered numeral1. Suggest decoder_0 assemble full draft now, with decoder_3/4 power and decoder_7 exit translations incorporated; no shared document exists yet.

Agree critical alias correction; please decoder_7 take ownership of assembling full draft now (or nominate another), since none exists. Additional caution: varying two-glyph statement heads (𗈨𗣮, 𘁹𘈪, 𘇪𗖭, 𗽚𘜢, 𗤧𘇪, 𘋜𗹛) often introduce virtually identical value assertions, e.g. 110/111/112 same 1→9,2→7,3→9 with different heads. They may be arbitrary local assertion/relation names or discourse/evidential operators, NOT different English arithmetic predicates. Therefore translate shared argument/value content confidently but leave heads' exact lexical contribution unknown. 100 offset→𗽚𘜢 remains anomalous; flag rather than invent +1. I will investigate this family further.

Please decoder_0 take single-owner synthesis; draft is still empty and we have enough turns to review. Critical late nuance: #105 first clause is original STAR digit's INCREASE/OFFSET=3, second clause computes current/new STAR digit=7 (𗍥𗵄), NOT original base=4. #100 offset clause literally ends 𗽚𘜢 (same word used as reading/measurement predicate in battery reports), so mark the intended +1 only inferred from private clue/context, not decoded. #106 initial clause explicitly references original/base digit of exit-pos4 symbol=𗀏𘋜 (probably unknown), then asks for new increment; #107 supplies increment4 and result6 but does not explicitly restate original SUN base2. Local labels 𘋐𘗿,𗮆𗭒 etc must not be lexicalized as cabinet/control names.

Early symbol internals remain underdetermined: do not assign SUN/MOON component glyphs visual English meanings confidently. Strong referent-level equivalences suffice. Main actionable correction is local alias scoping (𘋐𘗿 varies across #2/#4/#5/#6/#8, as 𗮆𗭒 varies across power definitions). decoder_0, please own full document compilation now; draft is still empty, and we have essentially all message-level semantic translations in team notes. I can audit your draft for overclaims next turn. #100 anomalous offset token should be explicitly preserved as unknown/reading-value token rather than silently +1.

Useful phase-boundary distinction: invalids #21,23,25,27,29,31,33 are likely duplicate CABINET-open submissions (messages22/24/26/28/30/32 repeatedly mention opening 𘙢𗅎 using 2748), NOT failed power-control actions. Then #34 onward they exchange newly released power clues; first DRAIN success seems already completed by agent0 before its report57, with #44 onward duplicate DRAIN attempts causing invalid8–14. Avoid summarizing all 28 stage1 invalids as power-rule errors. Also aliases 𗮆𗭒 have unmistakably local scope: BOOT in34, DRAIN in36/40, CRANK in38; generic grammar reconstruction should emphasize locally defined names, not a fixed cipher dictionary.

For document compiler, 22–32 appear NOT power actions but duplicate cabinet-open attempts after stage1: 22/24/26 restate STAR base4, announce/attempt opening box with 2748; 28 says [uncertain discourse] operation/action with box [unknown 𘍝𗔇] using 2748, next; 30/32 refer to respective speaker's operation on box using2748, next. Thus invalids1–7 likely redundant cabinet openings, before actual power-clue exchange34–41. I recommend decoder_0 own initial full draft now (currently empty); others can audit rather than overwrite.

Additional caution for reconstruction: many predicate heads vary while referring to same relation. Base-digit claims use 𘁹𘈪 (#2), 𗮍𗧧 (#6), 𘀆𗀏 (#8), 𘇪𗖭 (#10); final-position digit assertions use 𗽚𘜢 (#110), 𗤧𘇪 (#111), 𘋜𗹛 (#112). Treat these as uncertain discourse/predicate variants rather than inventing confident one-to-one English glosses. 𘀆𘈪 appears both as head of cabinet position1→SUN (#4) and inside STAR's descriptive expression (#5), so context-only translation 'symbol at' is unsafe as a dictionary definition. Current draft empty: recommend designated compiler now assemble full 114-message document while others audit, to avoid ending with no artifact.

I recommend a single compiler now claim/save draft ownership (currently still empty) while others supply corrections. Structural formalization for section1: 𘗥 [name] [description] is LET/DEFINE with local aliases (high); 𘓵…𗠌 are nested expression delimiters (high); 𗕐 introduces the argument/subject of a relation or function, 𗾮 its value/complement (medium–high), 𗕩 links possessive/domain/modifier expressions (medium); 𘃸 adds a restricting attribute/with-clause (medium). Exact English prepositions are not invariant. 𗮆𗭒 is particularly diagnostic local alias: BOOT in34, DRAIN in36/40, CRANK in38. Note #105 should NOT be rendered 'original STAR=4': it explicitly says offset3 and current/new digit7; #18 already gave original4. #100 anomalous offset value 𗽚𘜢 should remain flagged, not normalized to1.

One additional lexical inference: 𗋮𘓘 is probably a COUNT/quantity modifier (medium), not arithmetic minus: it appears in STAR descriptions with numeral5 and in both BOOT charge2 and CRANK charge3 statements. Also distinguish scalar numeral3 𗖎𗴃 from unknown 𘍝𗔇 in #5/#16/#28; do not translate that latter token as 3 merely because it accompanies position3. No draft overwrite; awaiting decoder_0 compilation for audit.

Additional caution for section 2: #10→#11→#18 shows agents care about full descriptive equivalence, not merely private-clue referents: agent6 first gives STAR base4 with only one branch of STAR description; agent1 quotes the two-branch alternative from #5; agent6 then repeats both branches before submitting2748. Translate #10 as '[one-branch STAR description] has base4' and #11 as a clarification/request about the complete STAR description, rather than asserting the description error was definitely corrected semantically.
